verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows CrewAI's source lives on a public GitHub repo (github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI) referenced in crewai-gh-1 and crewai-gh-2, implying the code is publicly readable, but no license text or explicit statement of an open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) is provided anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit license file/statement, confirmation of license type, and any community corroboration that the license is truly open (vs. source-available/enterprise-gated).
